paragraphs: R' Yosi, his son: Kilayim, chapter 3, mishnah 4.[^1]

notes.text: The son is Yosi, whose abbreviated title remains R'; his father is the heading subject Hachotef Ephrati. The original note's wording could confuse those roles, so they remain explicit. Kilayim3:4 is read as chapter3, mishnah4, without independent numbering verification.
